class.name: NetwInterestStats
class.description: They belong to the pass that produced them rather than to the engine, so a pass that is computed and never committed carries its own counters away with it and the engine keeps reporting the last one it did commit. [member edges] is the size of the matrix being maintained and [member shows] plus [member hides] is how much of it moved. A session where the second stays near zero against a large first is one where recomputing is not the cost.

method.name: to_array
method.description: Every counter in the order they are declared below, for comparing two passes against each other.

members.member: Admitted entity and peer pairs in the matrix this pass produces.
Entity rows this pass recomputed. Entities nothing dirtied cost nothing.

Packed words each row occupies, which grows with the number of peers the session has seen.
